asr.full_text: www.NorthstarIT.co.uk Hello friends, Are you looking for steps to prevent the display of pop-ups while browsing the internet using Safari on a Mac-PC? Here's how you can do so. Click on the Go menu and then click on Applications from the menu that opens. On the Applications window, under the Productivity section, double-click on the Safari icon to open it. Click on the Safari menu and then click on Preferences. Click on the Security tab and then select the checkbox next to Block Pop-up Windows. On the confirmation window, click on the Block button to save and apply the changes. Wasn't that easy? Thanks for watching!
